description:
Snyk Code is the fastest & most comprehensive SAST code vulnerability scanning and auto-fixing tool. Try Snyk’s code scanner solutions for free, or book a live demo.

AI-Powered Code Analysis: Analyzes code to detect security vulnerabilities and coding issues. Automatic Fix Suggestions: Provides recommendations to fix identified problems. Integration with Snyk: Works alongside Snyk's other security tools for comprehensive protection. Support for Multiple Languages: Analyzes code written in various programming languages.
